entry.title: mpSEEJAY 1.3.0
entry.summary: mpSEEJAY 1.3.0 - **Browser:** FOLDERS, REKORDBOX, CHILL and HYPE sections. A rekordbox USB export's playlists show up (read-only). Each row has title, artist, BPM, stars and a CHILL/HYPE tag. Sort by order, artist, title, BPM or stars (pad 15). Stars on pads 3/4, CHILL/HYPE on pads 7/8. The browser stays open after a load. - **START page:** tap the waveform to move where a track starts (remembered per file). Silent intros are skipped automatically. - **Clock:** time played, time left at the curr

entry.title: mpSEEJAY 1.1.0
entry.summary: A new look: mpSEEJAY now looks like a piece of DJ hardware. Every control is where it was. - Backlit rubber pads that glow in their function's colour and sink when pressed - Keycaps for BPM +/-, RESET, BROWSE and the browser bar, with LEDs on LOAD A, LOAD B, EJECT and SYNC - DECK A / B keys lit in the deck colour - A metal jog with an LED ring in the deck colour (amber in a track's last 30 seconds) - LCD screens behind the track info, both tempos, the waveforms and the browser - LED beat counter

entry.title: mpSEEJAY 1.0.0
entry.summary: First release: two DJ decks for MPC standalone, made to play into an external DJ mixer. - One plugin per deck (A and B), each on its own track and output. - Both tempos and waveforms on screen; sync, pitch fader, BPM +/-, jog and nudge. - The 16 pads mirrored on screen and lit on the MPC (bank A: the deck; bank B: hot cues, rolls, loops). - Track browser over every drive, readable in the dark; tracks load into memory. - WAV and MP3, up to 15 minutes a track.
